I am interested in making a stacked dot plot like the one attached in ggplot2.  Any help on how how to accomplish this would be greatly appreciated.


This plot comes from BHH2 package which is fine but does not have the coloring and faceting functionalities of ggplot2.


library(BHH2)
data(tab03B1)
attach(tab03B1)
plt <- dotPlot(yield) # equivalent dotPlot
detach()
